thread:
lia: Starting release v2.15 canary window. Plan: slowstart enable of feature flag `recommendation-ux` (default OFF) using 1% initial target then ramp to 10% with 1% steps every 5m (slowstart). Canary cohort = cohort-ai-canary. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

 deploy-bot: [deploy] v2.15 deploy initiated on prod-cluster-2. Canary bucket: cohort-ai-canary.

 chris: Heads-up: pin model to rwd-model-2026-03-21 for the canary and leave pinned until 10% stable. I'll pin: `/infra pin-model --svc rec-ui --ver rwd-model-2026-03-21 --until 10pct`

 lia: command to start slowstart: `/ff set recommendation-ux --target 1 --mode slowstart --step 1 --interval 300 --reason "v2.15 slowstart canary"`

 deploy-bot: slowstart active: target 1%. Expect increments: 2% @ +5m, 3% @ +10m, ... up to 10%. Circuit-breaker: auto-disable if error_delta > 1.5% OR p99 latency +200ms OR memory_pressure > 85% on model nodes.

 release-coordinator: added runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/rec-ff-rollouts and release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/v2.15 :page_facing_up:

 pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note created for ops-oncall. Escalation policy: 15m -> eng-oncall -> se-sre.

 ops-oncall: I'll mute noisy alerts and surface only severity >= high. Quick checks: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, cpu, mem. Also watch KV cache hit-rate for the pinned model.

 chris: minor dashboard query to watch: `sum(rate(http_errors[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_requests[5m])) by (route)` for error delta. Also monitor embedding queue depth.

 deploy-bot: slowstart progress: 1% -> 4% -> 7% (no anomalous signals). Telemetry: error-rate +0.3%, p99 +40ms, mem 62%. Continuing to 10%.

 lia: At 10% we'll run a short smoke test on production traffic via `--test-cohort internal-smoke` then decide for 100% enable later tonight. If smoke fails, immediate rollback plan:
 1) `/ff set recommendation-ux --target 0 --force --reason "auto-rollback"`
 2) `/infra rollback-release --id v2.15 --drain 60s`
 3) `/infra unpin-model --svc rec-ui`

 chris: quick exec snippet for oncall to abort flag if needed (curl):
 `curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood/flags/recommendation-ux?action=set&target=0"`

 deploy-bot: slowstart reached 10% -> smoke test started. Smoke tests: login flows, rec render time, no NPEs on logs.

 pagerduty-bot: alert routed to eng-oncall for potential regression watch.

 ops-oncall: Smoke looks clean after 10m. No SLO breaches. Ready to schedule broader ramp. Recommend waiting 90m before 100% enable to observe steady-state.

 lia: agreed. I'll open a follow-up thread before the big ramp and post a short post-deploy checklist once we complete 100% or abort. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
